discussion: The public check fails because `_safe_relative_path('C:/outside.py')` is accepted instead of rejected. On POSIX, `PurePosixPath('C:/outside.py')` treats `C:` as a relative directory component, so `is_absolute()` returns False. I need to add a check for Windows drive-letter absolute paths (single letter + colon prefix) before the PurePosixPath check. The fix is to add `re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", normalized)` which catches drive-letter paths like `C:/...` or `C:...`.
